{{Top|leg}}
A '''narco-interrogation''' was a type of interrogative technique that was performed on prisoners of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The victim was injected with a pain-stimulating drug like [[Skirtopanol/Legends|Skirtopanol]] or [[Bavo Six|Bavo-6]], their nerves stimulated with heat, the effect artificially raised into progressively more pain, starting from level four and increasing upward. A powerful tool for extracting information or causing mental breakdown from unwilling captives for retraining them into secret agents, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] used the technique often, including on [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] while he was being held aboard the buried ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''. Both he and squadron pilot [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] were designated [[R1]], unsuitable for conversion through brainwashing.
